paite: Huan Ahab sih nung in Israelte tung ah Moabte ahel uhi.
heading: Elijah Leh Kumpipa Ahaziah

paite: Samaria a dantan tungnung vathangkalh tohlet a pan Ahaziah akekhia a, akihihnata hi. Huchi in mi asawl a, akiang uah, "Kuan unla, hiai ka natna ahoihkhe nawn thei hiam Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub va dong un," achi hi.

Himahleh TOUPA angel in Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah, "Thou inla, Samaria kumpipa misawlte houpih ding in kuantou inla, akiang uah, Israel gam a Pathian a-om louh ziak in hia Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub dong dia na hong kuan uh?
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei dia, na si ngeingei ding, chi in va gen in," achi hi. Huchi in Elijah akuanta hi.
Amisawlte akiang ah ahong kik nawn un akiang uah, "Bang achi a ahia na hong kik nawn mawk uh?" achi hi.

Amau akiang ah, "Mi khat hong houpih ding in ahong a, ka kiang uah, pai unla, nou hon sawlpa kumpipa kiang ah kik nawn unla, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Israel gam a Pathian a-om louh ziak in hia Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub dong dia na sawl? Huchi in na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei ding a, na si ngeingei ding, chi in va hilh un ahon chi," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou hon houpih dia hong, huai thute hong hilhpa mi bangchibang ahia oi?" achi hi.
Amau adawng ua, "Samul puan a kizem ahi a, akawng savun kawnggak in agak," achi ua; ama'n, "Tishbi mi Elijah ahi ve," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n sepaih sawmnga heutu, aheute sawmnga toh akiang ah asawl hi. Mualvum a tu Elijah kiang ah ahohtou a, ama'n, "Nang, Pathian mi, kumpipa'n hong paisuk in, achi ve," achi hi.

Elijah in adawng a, sepaih sawmnga heutu kiang ah, "Pathian mipa ka hihleh van a pan mei hong kesuk henla, nangmah leh na heute sawmnga hong kangmang vek hen," achi hi. Huchi in van a pan mei ahong kia a, amah leh aheute sawmnga akangmang vek uhi.
Akiang ah sepaih sawmnga heutu dang, aheute sawmnga toh asawl nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Nang Pathian mi, kumpipa'n, hong paisuk meng in, achi ve," achi hỉ.

Elijah in adawng a, akiang ah, "Pathian mipa ka hihleh van a pan mei hong kesuk henla, nang leh na heute sawmnga hong kangmang vek hen,” achi hi. Huchi in Pathian mei van a kipan ahong kia a, amah leh aheute sawmnga akangmang vekta uhi.

Sepaih sawmnga dang heutu, aheute sawmnga toh asawl nawn a, huai sepaih sawmnga dang heutu akuantou a, Elijah ma ah ava khukdin a, akiang ah, "Pathian mipa aw, ka hinna leh hiai na sikha mi sawmngate hinna na mitmuh in manpha hen.
Ngai in, van a pan mei ahong kesuk a, sepaih sawmnga heutu nihte aheute sawmnga utoh akangmangta ua; huaiziak in ka hinna na mitmuh in manpha hen," chi in angen hi.
Huchi in TOUPA angel in Elijah kiang ah, "Kumsuk pih in, amaute lau ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in athou a, amah toh kumpipa kiang ah akumsukkhawm uhi.

Ama'n akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ekronte pathian Baal-zebub dong dia mite na sawl, Israel gam a dot ding Pathian a-om louh ziak hia? Huaiziak in na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei ding a, na si ngeingei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Elijah in agen TOUPA thu bang in asita hi. Tapa aneih louh ziak in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapa, Jehoram kum nih alal kum in, asik in Jehoram alalta hi.
Ahaziah thilhih tanchin dangte Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
